title: RBI Penalties on Non-Banking Financial Companies (Infinity Fincorp Solutions, Namdev Finvest Limited, and others)
description: <cite index="19-1,19-2">RBI imposed monetary penalties on 3 NBFCs by order dated August 3, 2026, for non-compliance with KYC Directions and Fair Practice Code provisions. Infinity Fincorp Solutions received a penalty of ₹5.40 lakh and Namdev Finvest received ₹2.70 lakh.</cite>
